Follow this repository's contribution guidance and existing review requirements.
Keep answers proportionate. Use "Not applicable" with a reason where needed.
Report checks actually performed and identify anything still unverified.
Do not include secrets, sensitive personal data, or confidential vulnerability details.
-->

## Summary

<!-- Explain the problem, the changes, and the resulting behavior or content. -->

## Related work

<!-- Link the relevant issue, discussion, or plan, if any.
Use "Closes #..." only when this change fully resolves that issue. -->

## Validation

<!-- List checks or review steps, their results, and supporting evidence.
Include commands/environment or CI links where useful.
Record make quality evidence and relevant PDF/source-package review.
Identify checks not run, failures, and remaining limitations. -->

## Impact and compatibility

<!-- Describe effects on users, interfaces, data, dependencies, or configuration.
Describe canonical LaTeX, citation, accessibility, or deterministic packaging changes.
Include migration or rollback notes where relevant; otherwise explain why not. -->

## Documentation and follow-up

<!-- Identify affected documentation, examples, or release notes.
Preserve author and upload gates; preparation does not establish arXiv submission.
Record remaining work and explain any documentation updates that do not apply. -->

## Author checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and kept this change focused.
- [ ] I supplied validation evidence and disclosed checks not completed.
- [ ] I considered security/privacy and unintended sensitive content.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation or explained why none is needed.
